title: Sample runs
description: engine/samples.json: the runs `langc check --samples` evaluates in order (lang/SPEC.md §5.3, lang/compiler/src/samples.rs). The engine profile's inputs are state, event, timestamp and gps (engine/PROFILE.md).

runs.description: Evaluated in order. A run with `chain` takes inputs from the output of the run before it.

inputs.description: The inputs by name, as JSON (null for a nil nullable input). An input named in `chain` is taken from the previous output instead.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: an input name is letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit

chain.description: Input name → `output` or `output.<path>` of the run before this one, e.g. {"state": "output.state"}.
